# YogaGarhi

> YogaGarhi is a traditional, Yoga Alliance certified yoga school offering authentic 100-Hour, 200-Hour, and 300-Hour Yoga Teacher Training Courses (YTTC) in Ubud, Bali (Indonesia) and Rishikesh (India). Rooted in authentic Himalayan lineage, the school emphasizes small batch sizes (8–10 students), personalized mentorship, and multi-style yoga education.

## Core Courses & Certifications

- [200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali](https://www.yogagarhi.com/200-hour-yoga-teacher-training-in-bali): Comprehensive 24-day residential Yoga Alliance RYT 200 certification program in Ubud, Bali. Covers Hatha, Vinyasa Flow, Ashtanga Primary Series, Iyengar-inspired alignment with props, Pranayama, Meditation, Applied Anatomy, and Yoga Philosophy.
- [100-Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali](https://www.yogagarhi.com/100-hour-yoga-teacher-training-in-bali): 12-day immersive foundational course in Bali designed for beginners and practitioners looking to deepen their personal practice and yogic lifestyle.
- [300-Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali](https://www.yogagarhi.com/300-hour-yoga-teacher-training-in-bali): Advanced 28-day Yoga Alliance RYT 300 training for graduates of a 200-hour YTTC, leading to RYT 500 qualification. Focuses on advanced sequencing, yoga therapy, and advanced philosophy.
- [200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Rishikesh](https://www.yogagarhi.com/200-hour-yoga-teacher-training-in-rishikesh): Traditional Himalayan yoga immersion located in the yoga capital of the world, Rishikesh, India.
- [100-Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Rishikesh](https://www.yogagarhi.com/100-hour-yoga-teacher-training-in-rishikesh): 100-hour foundational training on the banks of the sacred Ganges River in Rishikesh.

## What Makes YogaGarhi Unique

- **Himalayan Lineage**: Founded and guided by experienced yogacharyas following authentic traditional roots, integrating Patanjali Yoga Sutras, Hatha Yoga Pradipika, and Bhagavad Gita.
- **Intimate Batch Sizes**: Strictly capped at 8–10 students per batch to ensure dedicated individual attention, proper alignment adjustments, and safe practice.
- **World's First Pre-YTTC Prep**: Optional complimentary online preparation program before arriving in Bali or Rishikesh to help students build confidence in basic asanas, Sanskrit terms, and anatomy.
- **Multi-Style Approach**: Thorough training in classical Hatha Yoga, dynamic Vinyasa, traditional Ashtanga Vinyasa, and Iyengar alignment methodology.
- **Holistic Living**: Includes 3 nutritious daily Sattvic vegetarian/vegan meals, comfortable residential accommodation (private villas & shared rooms), airport pick-up, Balinese massages, and cultural excursions (waterfall treks, ancient temple ceremonies).
- **Post-Course Mentorship**: Ongoing 1-year mentorship and lifetime re-attendance opportunities for graduates.
